title: Davis told definitively that we are monitored and do not control our space

tellings.quote: 100. Because it was definitive. It was that was told to me definitively, not speculatively. It was we know this to be true.

plain: A physicist who has worked for the Pentagon, Eric W. Davis, says he was told that humans are being watched and do not control their own airspace, and that this was said to him as fact, not guesswork: "we know this to be true." He tells it on the show, putting his confidence at 100 percent, without naming who told him. If true, it would mean someone in the know has concluded we are not alone or in charge of our skies.
